subject: Marketplace procurement and billing path — LumenAI
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Anand Rao <anand@lumenai.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace procurement and billing path — LumenAI

Hi Anand — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Procurement path: you mentioned you prefer to buy through AWS Marketplace (supported) but also wanted clarity on PO vs card payment and how listing affects billing cadence.
- Paper process: you said legal/procurement usually needs a Master Subscription Agreement + PO; timeline ~4–6 weeks (is that still accurate?).
- Technical: you'll want a short checklist for Marketplace listing (what we provide vs what you need).

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll send over a short pricing sheet + SOW draft and an AWS Marketplace checklist (attached).
2) If procurement prefers PO, we can provide a standard PO template and a DocuSign MSA to speed review; if they want to use card, we can provision access immediately.
3) Schedule a brief call next week to loop in your procurement contact and go over timelines.

Can you confirm the procurement contact and the expected timeline? Also, is AWS Marketplace the only path you want to explore or should we include GCP Marketplace as an option?

Thanks — cc'ing Jonas (SE) so he can prepare the marketplace checklist and SOW updates.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_sheet_redwood_v1.pdf (application/pdf), SOW_redwood_lumenai_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), aws-marketplace-listing-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Anand Rao <anand@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace procurement and billing path — LumenAI

Thanks Camila — great session. Quick answers below: 

- Procurement contact: procurement@lumenai.com (procurement team) and myself (Anand) as the internal sponsor.
- Timeline: estimate 4–6 weeks once we open the procurement ticket. We typically need an MSA and a PO; credit card is only used for pilots or < $5k purchases, so we will likely go the PO route for production.
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is preferred by procurement; we can consider GCP later but not a blocker now.

Could you send the MSA + PO template and the finalized pricing? Also can you confirm whether listing on AWS Marketplace changes the billing entity (we need to know tax/invoicing details for our finance team).

Thanks — I’ll get procurement@lumenai.com looped in on the call you propose.

Best,
Anand
Head of Platform
LumenAI

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Anand Rao <anand@lumenai.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, procurement@lumenai.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace procurement and billing path — LumenAI

Great, thanks Anand — looping procurement here. A few clarifications and attachments: 

- Attachments: final pricing sheet (v1) + SOW draft + AWS Marketplace checklist (see attachments). The pricing sheet includes both hosted (Redwood API) and Dedicated pricing bands; we’ve highlighted the recommended plan for your projected throughput.
- AWS Marketplace impact: if you purchase through AWS Marketplace (Seller Private Offers or SaaS contracts), billing/invoicing flows through AWS; Redwood will receive payment via AWS and issue usage reports. For tax/invoice specifics we can attach our W-9 / tax form and provide the marketplace seller details. If you need Redwood to invoice LumenAI directly via PO (off-marketplace), we can do that as well — both are supported.
- PO vs Card: for production we recommend PO (standard). For pilots under $5k you can use card for immediate access.

Proposed next steps:
1) Jon and I will prepare a slightly updated SOW (we'll insert the expected start date and scope).
2) We can prepare an AWS Private Offer if procurement prefers that route — that usually speeds approval since it integrates with your AWS billing.
3) Let’s schedule a 30-minute procurement sync next Tue (Mar 23) at 10am PT. Does that work for procurement?

Jonas — can you confirm the checklist items we sent are complete and add any technical onboarding notes we should highlight to procurement?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_sheet_redwood_v1.pdf, SOW_redwood_lumenai_draft.docx, aws-marketplace-listing-checklist.pdf

From: Anand Rao <anand@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, procurement@lumenai.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace procurement and billing path — LumenAI

Thanks Camila — procurement@lumenai.com confirms Tue Mar 23 10am PT works. A couple quick asks before that call: 

- Can you upload the MSA + DocuSign link and the PO template to the HubSpot deal or Google Drive link you referenced? procurement wants to start redlining.
- For the AWS Private Offer: can you confirm approximate lead time to have the offer ready once commercial terms are finalized?

If you can get the docs into HubSpot/Drive by end of day Friday (Mar 19), we’ll start internal review and should be able to meet the 4–6 week target.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Anand
Head of Platform
LumenAI
